subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional append?: boolean on the existing write tool and WriteOperations backend, or require a different append API before landing this data-loss fix?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible and default-preserving, but it expands the model-facing tool contract and backend operation contract, which needs maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve append?: boolean as the contract, then land one append-mode PR after current-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a separate append API
options.body: Ask for a dedicated append tool or mode-style API if maintainers want stronger separation from destructive overwrite semantics.

options.title: Pause for a narrower replacement
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if a narrower replacement proves the same behavior and becomes the canonical safe path.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve append?: boolean as the contract, then land one append-mode PR after current-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily an agent tool API shape decision, and steipete has relevant recent history on session tool contracts and structured tool definitions.
